title: First day using
body:
Nice app, enjoying it so far. Сolourful, a lot of customization options. What it’s missing is changing the start of the week from Sunday to Monday, in Europe the week starts on Monday, so it’s strange to make plans that start on Sunday. 
Also, I would really enjoy an opportunity to attach photos/videos/voice recordings to reflection notes, for example, when I write about a happy moment in my life, I really want to add a photo of it. 
I also wasn’t able to create a plan that would happen twice daily, like taking vitamins is twice a day (morning and evening), so I had to create two plans, which is not the end of the world, but just not very logical.

title: App is great but not having a free trial is a huge red flag
body:
There is no free trial and I won’t spend 100PLN or 200PLN for an app that I cant fully test out. It’s not a great deal if I can’t even see if it’s worth or not for even a day. Maybe it’s not much for american or eu standards but countried with weaker currency have to rely on reviews of others.

Aside from that the free features are just like in any other to-do routine creating apps. I like the personal touch on emojis making them more 3d and creating free challenges for all users (downside is that it has to be from a group of already created habits by developers). 
Pros:
- multiple small to-dos in one bigger panel (for example morning routine can be broke down on brushing teeth etc)
- nice personal touch on emojis
- multiple color coding options
- tags to organize it better (Virgos are shaking rn)
Cons:
- no free trials
- predecided to dos in challenges
- only yearly billing option
